note: Input placement on the seven-step host tick. Step numbers and ids are owned by the core fixture; this file adds input operations only and does not duplicate the core order. The core fixture names InputMapper.pollAll at step 2; the engine router replaces that call with InputRouter.poll at the same step.

inputOps.description: Copy each slot's pooled tilt state into the router before the poll.
Feed the synthesized InputSnapshot from the frame; legacy games keep reading it.
Read-only access to frame actions, pointer and focus.

forbidden.reason: poll is a host operation and must run before simulate
poll runs once per simulation tick, never per rendered frame
binding changes are host/UI operations and apply from the next poll
reset is a host lifecycle operation, never per-tick
capture is a UI operation outside simulate
